text: The awardee must provide all requested information for the Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) and acquisition-risk questionnaires, including FOCI, key management, and subcontractor details, for both parent and subsidiary levels.

citations.quote: The prospective awardee shall timely provide all information requested by the FBI to complete the PRA, including acquisition-risk, ownership/control, key-management, source, product, supply-chain, and subcontractor information as applicable.
A vendor that fails to provide information required to complete the PRA within the time established by the Contracting Officer may be determined ineligible for award.
Offerors will be asked to answer and provide information responsive to acquisition-risk questions to assist the Government in assessing whether the acquisition poses a national security risk.
All answers shall be reflective of the parent and subsidiary levels of an organization.

Offerors are also required to request, collect, and forward to the Government answers to these acquisition-risk questions from all subcontractors providing any equipment or software in performance of the contract or order.
Offerors are responsible for the thoroughness and completeness of each subcontractor's submission.
Offerors selected for PRA review are required to answer the acquisition-risk questions requested by the FBI.
All answers are to be reflective of the parent and subsidiary levels of an organization.
Offerors are responsible for the thoroughness and completeness of any required subcontractor submission.

Responses shall specify, where necessary, the identity, nature, degree, and impact of any Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) on the organization or its activities, or the organization or activities of a subcontractor.
The Offeror shall submit, when requested, a Key Management Personnel Listing (KMPL) and FBI supplemental acquisition-risk questionnaire.
The KMPL shall identify corporate management personnel by full legal name, position, date/place of birth, and citizenship status.
The Offeror may not seek reimbursement from the Government for costs associated with responding to this RFQ or a PRA request as a result of a non-approval decision.

text: Invoices must be submitted electronically via the IPP system in accordance with FBI-0023, with all supporting documentation uploaded, submitted at least monthly, and finalized within 30 days of the period of performance end date.

citations.quote: Invoices shall be submitted in accordance with FBI-0023, Federal Bureau of Investigation Electronic Invoicing Requirement.
Vendors are required to create and submit electronic invoices using the IPP system.
All supporting documentation shall be uploaded into IPP.
Invoices must be submitted at least monthly but no more than bi-weekly.
Final invoices must be submitted within 30 days after the end date of the period of performance.
If the Contractor has already enrolled in IPP, it shall coordinate with its IPP account administrator to add users as necessary.
